evidenceClasses.declared-missingness: Explicit unknown interval with null contents and no asserted transfer.
evidenceClasses.getty-acquisition-part: Native transferred_title_of/from/to relations in a Getty Activity Acquisition part; not an Onto2D legal-title finding.
evidenceClasses.getty-before-after: Native bidirectional Getty Activity ordering relation.
evidenceClasses.getty-current-location: Native current_location relation, kept separate from owner.
evidenceClasses.getty-current-owner: Native current_owner relation; relation start and legal title remain unknown.
evidenceClasses.getty-current-relation: Current context retained from the frozen HumanMadeObject response.
evidenceClasses.getty-referred-to-by: Native object-to-LinguisticObject source reference; no ownership inference.
evidenceClasses.regime-projection: Deterministic comparison under one named equivalence regime.

identityRegimes.actors-unordered: Do both views mention the same actors when role and time are deliberately ignored?
identityRegimes.complete-evidence-chain: Can the records establish the same complete, evidence-backed chain?
identityRegimes.direct-records: Do both views preserve the same ordered directly encoded activities?
identityRegimes.gap-explicit-chain: Do both views contain the same ordered sequence including explicit unknown intervals?
identityRegimes.physical-object: Do both views refer to the same exact Getty HumanMadeObject URI?

boundary.note: Native source relations are not legal-title, authenticity, restitution, or complete-chain determinations. Historical Load is undefined, not zero.
boundary.summary: Getty records, derived history projections, and explicit missingness remain visibly separate.
